login.title: Sign in
login.intro: We'll send you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
login.noAccessBody: Your account isn't linked to any operator yet. Ask the operator for an invitation.
login.phoneHint: With the country code, e.g. +44 7700 900123 or +40 722 123 456
login.phoneInvalid: Enter the full number with the country code, e.g. +44 7700 900123.
login.emailInvalid: That email address doesn't look right.
login.codeHint: The code is valid for a few minutes.
login.codeWrong: The code is wrong or has expired. Check the digits or ask for a new code.
login.chooseIntro: You work with several operators. Choose one to continue; you can switch at any time.
login.noMembershipBody: Your account isn't linked to any operator yet. If you're an affiliate, open the invitation link the operator sent you.

join.cannotUse: This invitation can no longer be used.
join.invalidLink: The link isn't valid or the invitation has already been used. Ask the operator for a new one.
join.title: {tenant} invites you to be an affiliate
join.intro: Recommend their trips to tourists, with your QR code or by booking for them, and earn a commission on every paid booking.
join.expiredBody: Ask the operator to send you a new invitation.
join.nameHint: This is how the operator and your colleagues will see you.
join.forAfter: . Sign in with your phone number or email to accept it.
